feature_contract.goal: Keep the DX9Ex R84 DirectGPU OpenXR host producer ring safe across late history publication, skipped unsampled frames, Reset and restarted game processes: release only strictly older frames from the selected same-run stereo source while the newest frame retains GPU-EVENT ACK.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R41 skipped-frame early ACK of the R84 DirectGPU host path; never change selected frame GPU completion fencing, copy/sampling path, stereo projection, original game input/FFB, SkyGlow, R26_SAFE fallback or frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Confirmed C++ R41 early-ACK loop excluded the selected frame but did not require skipped candidates to precede it or match selected runGeneration/PID; PublishCompletedFrame releases producer slots before D3D11 reads. This is a provable frame-lifetime safety defect, not a measured FPS gain or HMD-proven visual failure.
trace_stages: DX9Ex R84 D3D9 game publishes each DirectGPU frame with frameId, transport generation, game runGeneration, game PID and producer slot to the Frame.v2 ring.

R23 host ReadHistory and R41 Pick choose one newest eligible presentation frame; the old R41 loop could invoke PublishCompletedFrame on another valid-slot frame sharing only transport generation, without ensuring oldness or run identity.

The new pure C++ admission helper gates early ACK to strictly older same-run frames beyond last presented cursor; the selected live frame continues its existing D3D11 GPU EVENT ACK and OpenXR per-eye frame submission.
subcomponents: Enforce selected-frame temporal ordering and selected transport/run/PID identity before publishing skipped-frame producer ACK; exclude current/newer and previous game-run slots.
Preserve frameId serial wraparound semantics, older-frame high-frequency reclamation, exact selected frame GPU fence and original R26_SAFE/desktop fallback.
Compile positive and negative helper contract inside actual Windows R23 host and keep independent portable C++ smoke for wraparound, older/newer, stale PID/run, and already displayed frames.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 game published DirectGPU producer frame to R23 host ring selection and GPU-event release
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Only an unsampled frame strictly older than the chosen present frame, from the same transport generation, runGeneration and PID, may receive immediate ACK; selected frame retains asynchronous consumption fencing.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Game restart, stale run PID, frameId wraparound, and duplicate/later producer slots
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: After game restart old-run slot cannot be released under new-run selection; a newer frame or already-displayed frame is not freed, while safe wraparound older frame remains eligible.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Default R84 Windows host, R84 x86 game, R26_SAFE, package and domain isolation
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All required DX9Ex Active and Domain Isolation plus affected Full Source GitHub Actions pass on exactly one final validation-bearing SHA; real Quest3 VDXR behavior remains UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Before this source commit the R41 skip loop checked same transport generation, nonselected frame and slot validity but no earlier-than-selected condition or exact selected runGeneration/PID.
source_trace: D3D9 R84 publishes frameId, runGeneration, DirectGeneration and clientPid in SharedRenderFrameState.
R23 ReadHistory/Pick selects a current frame but old skip loop applied only DirectGeneration/current cursor in its PublishCompletedFrame branch.
PublishCompletedFrame ACKs producer reuse prior to any further D3D11 rendering of the selected frame; R32 selected frame ACK correctly waits for an EVENT fence.
diagnosis.root_cause: Missing selected-epoch and selected-frame temporal eligibility in the early ACK branch permitted producer slot release of any other eligible same-transport-generation frame rather than strictly older skipped frames.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally hold all skipped frames: that stalls the producer ring and restores R37 four-frame latency.
Do not publish selected frame ACK before its D3D11 EVENT: this could recycle textures while the GPU is still sampling them.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Committed R23 calls OutRunVrDirectRingSkipAck::CanAcknowledge with candidate, selected frame and last displayed frame IDs, matching generation/runGeneration/PID and original serial comparison before PublishCompletedFrame.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic smoke PASSED locally for frameId wraparound, future-frame, stale PID/run, already displayed; real R23 includes static_assert compile regression cases.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: No stereo eye transform changes; both original DirectGPU eyes keep the selected producer slot protected by the existing GPU EVENT, while only previous unconsumed candidate frames may be released without a GPU read.

ci_evidence.initial_policy_failure: RUN_RECORD_NOT_FOUND before x86 game/x64 host/package jobs

runtime_evidence: No same-SHA Quest3/VDXR game/HMD test. Renderer and real-world FPS not claimed.
